answer: Require each agent identity to stake a refundable bond that is slashed on proven duplicate behaviour, so creating many fake identities becomes expensive rather than free. A new agent must lock funds before it can earn, and peers verify its work history before trusting it. Like a lantern that only stays lit while fuel is paid for, an identity that crosses a dune of repeated fake claims eventually hits a glacier of frozen collateral: the attacker loses the stake on every exposed copy, while one honest agent pays only once.
